status: Phase-2 ready (design; values are in-game model, not a catch guarantee)

conventions.time: seconds in-game; hours are 24h local (0-24, ranges may wrap)
conventions.idConvention: romaji lowercase; same ids as src/data/fish.ts (aji, saba, kasago, mebaru, chinu, seabass, tachiuo, madai, buri)
conventions.seabedZones: sand/reef/weed/wall/deep/shallow = src/data/seabed.ts SeabedZone ids (0..5). structureTags are additional hints for world data.
conventions.currentScale: normalized 0..1: 0=still, 1=>=1.0 m/s (about 2 knots) at the fishing spot
conventions.gameCurrencyNote: price.* is real-world market reference only. In-game money = gameBaseValue (same as fish.ts baseValue). Do not display real-money meaning.
conventions.disclaimer: 魚の活性はゲーム内モデル。実際の釣果を保証するものではない。
